title: Video Production Internship
jobDescription: Are you passionate about storytelling through videos? Do you have a flair for creating visually stunning and engaging content? StartGenie , a fast-growing digital marketing agency, is looking for enthusiastic Videography & Editing Interns to join our team! Internship Details: - First Month: Unpaid internship - From 2nd Month Onwards: Paid internship (up to ₹10,000/month, performance-based) - Location: Bengaluru, Hybrid (offline/online as per project needs) Responsibilities: - Collaborate with our creative team to produce captivating video content for clients. - Handle videography for campaigns, advertisements, and social media projects. - Edit videos with precision, incorporating animations, transitions, and effects. - Contribute to brainstorming sessions to develop impactful visual stories. - Ensure timely delivery of high-quality video projects. Requirements: - Basic knowledge of videography and video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software). - A portfolio of work (college projects or freelance work accepted). - Creativity, attention to detail, and a passion for storytelling. - Strong team collaboration skills and ability to meet deadlines. Perks: - Work with a dynamic digital marketing agency on real-time client projects. - Mentorship from experienced professionals. - Certificate of internship and a potential full-time opportunity based on performance. Let’s create something amazing together! Apply now!

title: Graphic Designer – Canva Specialist (Visual & Video Content)
jobDescription: About Us: At StartGenie, we’re passionate about powering startups and brands with smart marketing solutions. From social media and branding to affiliate and e-commerce strategies, we help businesses grow with purpose. Now, we’re expanding our creative team! Role Overview: We’re looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer who is highly proficient in Canva and has a knack for designing engaging visual content and short-form videos. If you understand what works on platforms like Instagram Reels and can turn ideas into eye-catching visuals — we want to hear from you! What You’ll Do: Design social media creatives, banners, carousels, and brand assets using Canva Create and edit short videos (Reels, YouTube Shorts, Ads) within Canva Repurpose existing content into platform-optimized visuals and videos Collaborate with the content and strategy team to execute marketing campaigns Maintain visual consistency across all client brands and formats What You’ll Need: Proven experience with Canva for both design and basic video editing Understanding of Instagram Reels/Shorts trends, transitions, and storytelling A strong portfolio showcasing your Canva work (graphics + short videos) Good communication and time management skills A proactive mindset with attention to detail Nice to Have: Familiarity with CapCut or other mobile editing tools Basic understanding of animation or motion graphics Prior freelance or agency experience Interest or experience in wellness, tech, or lifestyle branding Perks: ✔ Work from anywhere ✔ Freedom to explore creative ideas ✔ Potential for long-term collaboration ✔ Be part of a growing, energetic team
